read_set: union of write stars in closed face-conflict neighborhood
declared_conflict_graph: square of face write-conflict graph G
safe_concurrent_events: distance at least3 in G; no write intersects another read
Kminus: G squared is K7, so universally footprint-independent batches have size at most1
geometric_bound: pseudomanifold face valence<=2 gives max degree(G)<=6, max degree(G squared)<=36; local reads<=15,writes<=3
protocol_requirement: consistent local read, exclusion of conflicting writes until commit, exact local receipt
protocol_registers: not sourced or implemented as native carrier variables
hard_permissions: fixed supplied input; concurrent changes need added read/write accounting
